ideas.pitch: An AI-powered graph intelligence and risk detection platform specifically engineered to flag fraudulent medical billing, fake insurance claims, and money laundering rings across public and private digital healthcare systems.
ideas.title: MediGraph AML Fraud Shield
ideas.track: Smart Systems Track: Digital Healthcare / Banking Fraud Detection
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets two of the official innovation tracks (Digital Healthcare and Banking Fraud Detection) by combining graph intelligence with explainable AI, mirroring the winning strategy of Bito.

ideas.pitch: A public sector risk forecasting dashboard utilizing Poisson regression and rolling backtests to predict infrastructure bottlenecks and administrative compliance incidents before they impact public delivery.
ideas.title: GovPulse AI-Incident & Public Sector Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns tightly with the Public Sector domain of the Smart Systems Track and implements rigorous statistical modeling similar to top-tier winners.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven patient acquisition and trust engine custom-built for digital healthcare clinics in India to manage patient onboarding, multilingual intake triage, and automated follow-up workflows.
ideas.title: TrustDentist Patient Acquisition Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Builds on a proven 1st-prize architecture designed for rapid deployment during tight sprint windows while directly addressing the Digital Healthcare track.

ideas.pitch: Satellite monitoring system that uses computer vision and geospatial analysis to automatically flag illegal industrial encroachment and environmental compliance violations for public sector auditing.
ideas.title: GreenTrace Satellite Land & ESG Compliance
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines hard engineering in computer vision with a real public sector use case, leveraging the proven runner-up formula of spatial compliance monitoring.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent nutritional support platform tailored for student and public healthcare populations that generates personalized meal plans and real-time dietary insights using RAG workflows.
ideas.title: NutriCare AI Campus Wellness Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages multi-agent architecture and personalized RAG workflows, mirroring hackathon-winning setups designed to deliver high user engagement under tight deadlines.
